title: Meerkat Pups Learn to Hunt From Teachers Using Live Scorpions

scenes.text: Meerkats go to school. The first lesson is a scorpion.
A scorpion sting hurts, so the teachers don't hand over a live one straight away.
Helpers often remove the sting first, or feed pups dead prey.
Then injured prey. Then fully live prey, as the pup gets older.
They know a pup's age from its begging call, and they adjust the lesson to match.
If the prey escapes, the teacher catches it, disables it again, and brings it back. Class is in session.

description:
Wild meerkats teach their pups to hunt, starting with dead prey and ending with live scorpions.
Helpers, often the pups' older relatives, adjust each lesson to the pup's age, judged by its begging call.
What's the hardest thing you ever had to learn? Comment below.
first_comment: The study was published in Science in 2006, and it is one of the best examples of real teaching in animals. Which animal do you think teaches next?
